stances_toward.note: Not a claim and not a target: Canada recognises the Kingdom's sovereignty and works with Nuuk. The consulate opened in early February 2026, with the Governor General Mary Simon at the ceremony, expresses the Arctic Foreign Policy of December 2024 and the Inuit link between Nunavut and Greenland; Foreign Minister Anand presented it as a way to strengthen Arctic security, climate and Inuit cooperation. Partner, warming. Bond kin: the Inuit peoples on both sides of Nares Strait. Mirror: the Denmark card holds Greenland as own_territory and the USA card as claimed_territory; Canada's reading sits on the Danish side.

stances_toward.note: Part of the Realm with self-government since 2009; Copenhagen keeps foreign and defence policy and pays the block grant, but the Self-Government Act (section 21) gives the people of Greenland the right to decide on independence, subject to a referendum and Folketing consent. Nuuk's government (Nielsen, Demokraatit, since March 2025) opposes joining the US but is also a negotiating party: the Danish line is that Greenland's red line is Denmark's. Own territory, but not a territory Denmark can dispose of alone. Bond - kin: the Realm, with a colonial history that the 2025-26 crisis has reopened.

stances_toward.note: The one territorial claim of the card, and a contested reading. Washington has said since 23 Dec 2024 that ownership is 'an absolute necessity', refused to rule out force until Davos (21 Jan 2026), threatened 'the hard way' (9 Jan 2026), told Greenland's leader 'no going back', and on 7 Jul 2026 at Ankara restated that Greenland 'should be controlled by the US, not Denmark'; the NDS lists it among the key terrain of the Trump Corollary. The trilateral agreement of 22 Sep 2026 gives bases, not sovereignty - Trump calls it 'permanent control', Copenhagen and Nuuk say nothing moved - so the claim is satisfied in Washington's words and withdrawn in no document. Claimed, not controlled, hence the grade; the alternative reading is partner (Nielsen signed the agreement). Stable: the claim was restated through 2026. Bond - none. Greenland's own side ('we choose Denmark', 13 Jan 2026) is not yet written.
